en.name: CodeX
en.ability: Once per game, on your Xth night, choose players X times in total: they are poisoned until dusk. Players chosen more than once die instead.

revisions.v1: Once per game, on your Xth night, choose players X times in total: they are poisoned until dusk. Players chosen more than once die instead.

en.firstNightReminder: The CodeX might choose players X times, X being how many nights they have been the CodeX (tonight included).
en.otherNightReminder: The CodeX might choose players X times, X being how many nights they have been the CodeX (tonight included).

zh.name: 代号X
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在你的第X个夜晚，你可以选择任意玩家共X次：他们中毒直到下个黄昏。被多次选择的玩家改为死亡。
